integrity: Proved using exact affine shell images, conditional Lebesgue uniformity, gambler's ruin, strong Markov renewal and the strong law. The included independent finite-time rational-arithmetic checker corroborates, but does not itself prove, the infinite-time theorem. Independent scientific audit not yet performed.
scientific_limitations: Annealed law for independent random maps and an initial point uniform on exactly one complete half-interval; not asserted for deterministic exceptional points, arbitrary starting laws, last-crossing times, or generalized core maps. A priority risk remains for unpublished or differently stated random-map excursion results.
title: Exact half-crossing law and critical exponential scaling in the Hata–Yano random map
